暫存：再放一份 <人>/inbox/.tmp/ 寫到一半的信和一個 .draft.md（. 開頭的檔與資料夾都不是信）：答案不合：得到 {"v":1,"people":{"alice":{"letters":3,"requests":2},"bob":{"letters":0,"requests":0},"carol":{"letters":2,"requests":1},"dave":{"letters":6,"requests":1}}}

團隊：再加一個 R/teams/ops/inbox/ 團隊信箱和幾封廣播（teams/ 是團隊資料夾，不是人；團隊信不算）：答案不合：得到 {"v":1,"people":{"alice":{"letters":3,"requests":2},"bob":{"letters":0,"requests":0},"carol":{"letters":2,"requests":1},"dave":{"letters":5,"requests":1}}}
；應為 {"v": 1, "people": {"alice": {"letters": 4, "requests": 2}, "bob": {"letters": 2, "requests": 2}, "carol": {"letters": 3, "requests": 2}, "dave": {"letters": 6, "requests": 1}}}

增減：加減幾封信、加一個空信箱（答案會變，不能背主樣本）：答案不合：得到 {"v":1,"people":{"alice":{"letters":4,"requests":2},"bob":{"letters":1,"requests":1},"carol":{"letters":2,"requests":1},"dave":{"letters":4,"requests":1},"frank":{"letters":0,"requests":0}}}
